issue: An off-route Settings page used the Settings-entry recovery, sending the user back to the beginning instead of returning one page within the current task.
root_cause: Local off-route handling offered opening Settings even when the existing task already had a previous native page.

behavior.automatic_mode: Request one native Back on the same verified Settings page. No repeat on an unchanged page; bounded to three recoveries until a valid guide resumes.
behavior.resume: Read the returned screen and observe using the same session, episode, goal and acknowledged server version.
behavior.unchanged_or_failed_back: Stop loading and provide an actionable Back retry; no automatic Settings restart.
behavior.initial_settings_entry: Retained when no task page has been observed.
safety: No Back from another app, dialog, sensitive input or locked screen.
Old callbacks cannot act after navigation, pause or stop.
A recovery action can execute once per presentation.
No setting change or previous action approval is replayed.

covered_cases: single detour with same session and episode
first request still in flight while detouring
old response version acknowledged before observation
initial Settings entry and sensitive/external environment regressions

limits: Behavioral recovery checks used a controlled Android service/gateway in Robolectric.
APK installation and identity were verified on the phone; a full real-device detour episode was not replayed automatically.
